newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves 5.41 bln-rupee foreign projects.
newsitem.headline: India approves 5.41 bln-rupee foreign projects.

text.p: The Indian government on Wednesday cleared 63 foreign projects worth 5.41 billion rupees, a statement said.
The statement said the industry ministry cleared projects in engineering, electronics, power and financial services.
U.S.-based E.M. Warburg Pincus & Co Inc has received approval to invest 371.0 million rupees in a venture to market and distribute telecom hardware, cellular and paging services.
Pulp and paper machinery maker TMT Ltd will seek an investment of 3.27 billion rupees from non-resident Indians, the statement said.
The government also approved $5 million investments by GM Locomotive Group India Ltd to provide support-services to Indian Railways.
The 63 projects are expected to earn India 19 billion rupees from exports over a period of five to seven years, the statement said. -- New Delhi newsroom +91-11-301 2024
